Providing Compassion and expertise for your pet on their cancer care journey.
Cancer touches everyone, even our beloved pets. You are not alone. All of us at the Animal Cancer Center of Texas are here to help. With continued advancements in veterinary medicine, there are many options available to allow our pets with cancer to live longer and better. Our team is committed to providing state-of-the-art diagnostics and comprehensive treatments for your pet in order to provide the very best quality of life for the longest period of time possible.
We believe in treating all of our clients and pets like family – through compassion, empathy, listening, honesty, and trust. Our goals are to guide you through the journey of diagnosis, treatment planning, and discussion of prognosis unique to your pet’s individual cancer. We want to empower you with the knowledge you need and encourage an active voice with the decision-making for your pet. Together we will customize the specific cancer care plan that suits the needs and expectations for you and your treasured pet. We make every effort to provide the highest level of communication and support along the way.
The team at Animal Cancer Center of Texas wishes to maintain comfort and happiness for all our pets living with cancer. Our pets do not understand that they have cancer nor understand their prognosis, so we want to ensure that they are living their very best life throughout the process.
From the ACCT family to yours, we hope that our compassion and dedication shows in all aspects of your experience here with us.
